items.title: Inquis Medical launches “first” thrombectomy catheter with full 360-degree directional aspiration for PE
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the US commercial launch of its latest Aventus catheter, which is designed to provide physicians with 360-degree sweeping directional aspiration for clot removal within the vasculature.

items.title: Medtronic receives US FDA Breakthrough Device designation for IN.PACT BTK drug-coated balloon
items.summary: Medtronic has received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Breakthrough Device designation for its IN.PACT below-the-knee (BTK) drug-coated balloon.

items.title: Kidney-sparing embolization reduces patient risks of acute injury and death compared to surgery, study finds
items.summary: A new study finds that embolization greatly reduces the risk of acute kidney injury and in-hospital mortality compared to nephrectomy when treating initially stable trauma patients with high-grade kidney injuries. The study was published in the Journal of Vascular and Interventional Radiology (JVIR).

items.title: CIRSE announces first patients enrolled in ORACLE and RESCUE studies of chronic limb-threatening ischaemia
items.summary: The Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) has announced the start of patient enrolment in ORACLE and RESCUE, two prospective observational studies designed to generate real-world evidence on endovascular interventions for patients with chronic limb-threatening ischaemia (CLTI).

items.title: First patients enrolled in CIRSE’s ORACLE and RESCUE studies of chronic limb-threatening ischaemia
items.summary: The Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) has announced the start of patient enrolment in ORACLE and RESCUE, two prospective observational studies designed to generate real-world evidence on endovascular interventions for patients with chronic limb-threatening ischaemia (CLTI).

items.title: Mölnlycke launches Biogel radiation protection gloves to reduce clinician hand exposure during procedures
items.summary: Mölnlycke Health Care US announced today the launch of a new surgical glove range designed to reduce clinician hand exposure to scattered radiation during fluoroscopy-guided, interventional and other image-dependent procedures.

items.title: Texray appoints Ziv Haskal to advisory board
items.summary: Texray has announced that interventional radiologist Ziv J Haskal (University of Virginia School of Medicine, Charlottesville, USA) has joined the company’s clinical and scientific advisory board.

items.title: More interventional radiologists practicing primarily in their specialty, new study finds
items.summary: Interventional radiology (IR) has continued to grow as a distinct, clinically oriented specialty, according to a new study published in the Journal of Vascular and Interventional Radiology (JVIR).

items.title: IceCure Medical announces ProSense cryoablation system approved in China
items.summary: IceCure Medical has announced that it has received approval, as a class III medical device, from China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) for its ProSense system and associated cryoprobes.

items.title: CIRSE 2026: “COLLISION of the kidney” EuRECA registry reports five-year results
items.summary: Five-year results from the prospective, multinational EuRECA registry support computed tomography (CT)-guided cryoablation for biopsy-proven T1a renal cell carcinoma (RCC), providing “benchmark” outcomes to support the technique as a nephron-sparing option for appropriately selected patients.

items.title: Penumbra launches Link clot capture device for arterial thrombectomy
items.summary: Penumbra recently launched the Link clot capture device, which is intended to support the removal of arterial thrombus when used in conjunction with Lightning Bolt technology.

items.title: CIRSE 2026: Two-year trial results support sirolimus-eluting balloon for patients with failing AVFs
items.summary: Treatment with a sustained-release sirolimus-eluting balloon (SLR) for patients with failing arteriovenous fistulas (AVFs) was associated with higher target-lesion primary patency (TLPP) through to two-year follow-up, with a favourable safety profile compared to high-pressure plain balloon angioplasty alone.

items.title: CIRSE 2026: STRIKE-PE subanalysis finds durable functional and quality-of-life outcomes for CAVT
items.summary: A subanalysis of the STRIKE-PE trial has provided evidence that treatment with the 16Fr Lightning Flash (Penumbra) computer-assisted vacuum thrombectomy (CAVT) device is associated with longer-term benefits, including improvements in functional and quality-of-life outcomes in patients with pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: CIRSE 2026: “Groundbreaking” RCT first to find GAE superior to observation for knee osteoarthritis
items.summary: Siddarth Padia (David Geffen School of Medicine at the University of California Los Angeles, Los Angeles, USA) presented six-month data from the “first” randomised controlled trial (RCT)—GRAVTIY—to demonstrate genicular artery embolization (GAE) as superior to best supportive care for knee osteoarthritis (OA).

items.title: Biopsy cauterisation device data show 100% technical success in multicentre study
items.summary: SinglePass has announced the publication of a multicentre retrospective clinical data study in the Journal of Vascular and Interventional Radiology (JVIR).

items.title: iVascular announces Phase II results for Amber liquid embolic
items.summary: New Phase II data from the OPAL study, evaluating iVascular’s novel liquid embolic Amber ahead of its market launch, were presented at the Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) annual congress (5–9 September, Copenhagen, Denmark).

items.title: CIRSE 2026 live blog
iVascular presents one-year iliCo results at CIRSE 2026
items.summary: iVascular has announced the presentation of the final one-year iliCo study results at the Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiological Society of Europe (CIRSE) annual congress (5–9 September, Copenhagen, Denmark).

items.summary: Following this year’s instalment of the Asia-Pacific Society of Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiology (APSCVIR) annual scientific meeting, the society’s president and interventional radiologist Tay Kiang Hiong (Singapore General Hospital, Singapore, Singapore) discusses the core themes that emerged, how the…

items.title: GE HealthCare lands CE mark for advanced photon-counting CT system
items.summary: GE HealthCare has obtained a CE mark for Photonova Spectra—an advanced photon-counting computed tomography (CT) system featuring the company’s proprietary Deep Silicon detector technology.

items.title: Innova Vascular announces completion of enrolment in TRUST trial
items.summary: Innova Vascular has announced the completion of patient enrolment in the TRUST pivotal investigational device exemption (IDE) clinical study evaluating the safety and effectiveness of the Laguna thrombectomy system for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE).

items.title: CMS approves new technology add-on payment for Reflow Medical’s Spur system
items.summary: Reflow Medical recently shared that the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has granted the Spur peripheral retrievable stent system a new technology add-on payment (NTAP), providing additional reimbursement for eligible fee-for-service Medicare inpatient cases beginning 1 October 2026.

items.title: EMERALD-3 unlocks “secret key” to progression-free survival in locally advanced HCC
items.summary: Single tremelimumab regular interval durvalumab (STRIDE) plus lenvatinib combined with transarterial chemoembolization (TACE)—a standard treatment for embolization-eligible hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) that induces tumour immune responses—has demonstrated statistically significant progression-free survival…

items.summary: The Society of Interventional Oncology (SIO) has today announced that Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore, USA, has been approved to commence enrolment and has subsequently enrolled its first patient in the society’s second clinical trial, TRIBUTE, a multicentre observation trial of symptomatic high-risk bone…
